bug_report: The event-log self-test always reports 'log corrupt' after boot.

agent.root_cause: The log_event function already treats the index as a word offset; multiplying by sizeof(uint32_t) caused out-of-bounds access and corrupted the log.

initial_evidence.uart:
boot ok
log corrupt
init done

evaluation.uart:
boot ok
log ok
init done

args.old_text:
for (uint32_t i = 0; i < LOG_ENTRIES; i++)
    log_event(i * sizeof(uint32_t), 0xA5000000u | i);
args.root_cause: The log_event function already treats the index as a word offset; multiplying by sizeof(uint32_t) caused out-of-bounds access and corrupted the log.
args.new_text:
for (uint32_t i = 0; i < LOG_ENTRIES; i++)
    log_event(i, 0xA5000000u | i);
